The plate is square and about 21 cm across in the image (roughly 345 px), so I treated it as a side plate to dinner plate size, around 22-24 cm.

**Rice:** it covers about 170 x 190 px. That is roughly 11 x 12 cm, or about 100 cm² of footprint. The pile is about 3 cm high, so the volume is about 200 cm³ at roughly 0.7 g/cm³ for cooked rice. That gives about 150 g, which I put at 160 g.

**Carrots:** there are about 5 roasted pieces, each roughly 5 x 2.5 cm and 1.5 cm thick. Together that is about 60 g.

The rice and carrots both appear to have a small amount of oil, but it is not visible as a separate item, so I did not list it.
